class.name: TerrainSculptLayer3D
class.brief_description: A painted layer of height offsets over the generated ground.
class.description: A freehand sculpt layer, as in Unreal's Landscape edit layers: a child of a [TerrainGenerator3D] that holds a painted map of offsets in metres. Paint it in the editor with the Paint Mask tool in the 3D toolbar: Add raises, Subtract lowers, Replace eases to a height and Smooth smooths. The generator adds the offsets in its touch-ups, so lakes and rivers settle round the sculpted ground, and keeps strokes finer than its cells. Layers stack in tree order; turning one off restores the ground.

method.name: get_offset_at
method.description: The layer's offset in metres at world [param x], [param z].

method.name: notify_height_map_changed
method.description: Re-reads the painted map after a stroke changed [param area] (in metres; empty for all of it).

members.member: The painted offsets: a one-channel float image in metres, times [member height_scale].
The ground [member height_map] covers, in metres (x, z, width, depth).
Scales every offset of the layer.
